data.description: Public holidays of a country, e.g. "holidays in Romania 2026". Data: Nager.Date.

data.prompt: The input asks about public holidays in a country. Reply with the country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. RO for Romania, DE for Germany, US for the United States), or XX if the input names no real country, and the year asked about, or 0 if the input names no year.
